scenes.title: A General Demoted to Soldier
scenes.summary: Max compares head chefs to generals and line cooks to foot soldiers as Viktor struggles with exhausting line-cook work at Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: The Doctor's Advice
scenes.summary: After another negative pregnancy test, Vika's doctor tells Max and Vika that they are completely healthy and advises them to work hard over the next two days.

scenes.title: The Arcobaleno Team
scenes.summary: Viktor asks Elena Pavlovna to tell him about the cooks at Arcobaleno and learns that sous-chef Misha is terrified of his wife.

scenes.title: Golden Hands and a Sharp Knife
scenes.summary: Elena tells Viktor about Kyrgyz cook Kanat and pastry ace Nadya while Misha dumps orders on Viktor, and at Claude Monet Max warns Kostya about Denis.

scenes.title: The Carrot Flute
scenes.summary: German catches Denis playing a flute carved from a carrot in the storage room and orders him to peel two sacks of potatoes before evening.

scenes.title: An Untimely Phone Call
scenes.summary: Just as Max and Vika start their doctor-prescribed romantic marathon at home, Denis calls begging for help with the two sacks of potatoes.

scenes.title: Brotherly Care
scenes.summary: German catches Max helping Denis peel potatoes on his day off and sends Max away, sparking a heated quarrel between the brothers.

scenes.title: A Trench Coat and an Interruption
scenes.summary: Vika arrives at the restaurant in a trench coat to seduce Max in the storage room, only for Denis to walk in to apologize and ruin the moment.

scenes.title: Levers of Influence
scenes.summary: When Elena leaves Misha in charge for twenty minutes, Viktor uses Kanat's cultural respect for elders to turn the tables on Misha.

scenes.title: The Godfather of the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Viktor uses a compromising photo of Misha and Nadya to blackmail Misha into obedience—until Misha's jealous wife arrives and drags Misha home.

scenes.title: Twenty Sacks of Potatoes
scenes.summary: When Denis finishes peeling the two sacks of potatoes, German claims he said twenty sacks and gives Denis one more day to peel the remaining eighteen.

scenes.title: Notes for Vika
scenes.summary: Elena sees through Viktor's manipulation of her kitchen at Arcobaleno, while Max passes written notes to Vika during work to apologize.

scenes.title: All of This Weighs on Me
scenes.summary: In the restroom, Vika confesses to Max that their silent quarrel and scheduled attempts to conceive are overwhelming her, and she walks away in tears.

scenes.title: Eighteen Sacks Before Evening
scenes.summary: After Denis spends the night away from the apartment so Max and Vika won't fight, the two brothers make up and tackle the eighteen sacks of potatoes together.

scenes.title: Control at Every Step
scenes.summary: Viktor loses his patience with Elena for hovering over him all day at Arcobaleno, while German catches Lyova helping Denis and sends him to peel potatoes too.

scenes.title: Efficiency Coefficient
scenes.summary: Because the whole kitchen secretly helped Denis peel all twenty sacks, German praises Denis's efficiency and fires two line cooks as redundant.

scenes.title: Quitting in Protest
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova quits in protest over German's treatment of the staff, the cooks try to sell the peeled potatoes, and Senya lures Vika and Max into the walk-in cooler.

scenes.title: The Locked Door and Reconciliation
scenes.summary: Locked inside the walk-in cooler by Senya, Max breaks down the door and reconciles passionately with Vika, while German introduces Lyova as sous-chef.
